data.name: Ai Love
data.detailed_description:
"包点先日了一手墙😡包点白给了br0😱没人给假门勾了😦该搜假门了😫假门😱是假门😭狗洞还在勾😦但是谁勾谁死😡假门😨假门😱假门啊漂亮😋直接补枪一个二打三"

声明
⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️

(在1.259版本后，英语版本已停止维护，仅保留系统内核更新。)

（本游戏已在6月4日确定即将进行下架流程。目前，团队自研的全新技术架构 Kirikiri KAGeXpress 3.0 Next Gen. 已正式发布，同时团队全新项目正在稳步立项推进。结合整体产品布局 Steam平台官方规则，现将《Ai 爱》停运下架、版本重制、玩家补偿等后续核心事宜，统一公示说明至置顶公告中。）

This project is primarily designed for technical experimentation and entertainment purposes. Following the 1.259 update, its main objective has shifted toward testing and evaluating various in-game system functionalities. With the exception of the core system components, we consider all other elements to be non-essential and not representative of a conventional gaming experience.

Please be advised that much of the content introduced in version 1.259 and subsequent updates may have adverse psychological effects on certain individuals and could potentially induce physical discomfort, such as nausea or dizziness. As such, we strongly advise against downloading or playing this game, as it may not be suitable for general audiences.

Should you choose to proceed despite these warnings, you assume full responsibility for any consequences. If you experience any adverse reactions, discontinue use immediately and seek prompt medical attention from a qualified healthcare professional.

⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️

Game Content Introduction

"I'm Liu Jie, you're Zhou Jing, and this is Xiao Han, right."

"Right."

"Um—ah—huh?"

The story of three people in Shizhong District—three individuals who embody an extremely laid-back vibe—
at a crossroads that belongs to the three of them.

You will play as a retard "Liu Jie," who has occupational habits. In the fast-paced life of a metropolis, through your main job as a new media worker and your side gig as a barista at a café, you'll spend one abstract yet ordinary day after another with your partners.

Every ordinary day we live might be a miracle unfolding in succession.

Who knows... Maybe Liu Jie is the greatest miracle of all.

Project Introduction

Ai Love serves as the prologue work of the series project Before The Rainbow, developed by 律合 Works in their spare time out of passion as an AVG (Interactive Fiction) game.

The project aims to facilitate technical exchange and entertainment through playful references, functioning as both a practical example and a (not-so) serious AVG game for players to enjoy. Everyone involved is contributing wholeheartedly to this project out of love.

Function and Gameplay Introduction

This game is built on KagEX2 Kag eXpress3 NextGen（Ver.Alpha）, with optimized and additional features that enhance the AVG gaming experience.

It combines AVG and ADV gameplay, interspersing small gameplay elements like cultivation, daily activities, and strategy within the story that can be progressed by pressing Enter. Players can experience the charm of abstract realism through the main story, which spans approximately 50,000 to 70,000 words.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows Vista
  • Processor: Pentium III 800MHz or higher (recommended 1GHz or higher)
  • Memory: 256 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 65536 colors (TrueColor, 16 bit) or higher (recommended 16777216 colors (FullColor, 32 bit)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: When using Steam content, an internet connection that supports accessing the Steam network is required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 7 9800X3D or higher
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 D or higher
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: When using Steam content, an internet connection that supports accessing the Steam network is required.

data.legal_notice: This game was developed with the assistance of the NVL Maker system. The underlying system is Kirikiri2 Kag3 KagEX2. The materials used in this game are marked with the author in the game, and the materials used in this game are self-purchased materials or original materials. The game is made in accordance with its terms and conditions. Some of the content of this game is produced using AI (Stable Diffusion), including but not limited to: CG images. During the production of the game, there were no irregularities. Everyone is welcome to supervise.
